Population increased in North Kesteven

The estimated population of North Kesteven in 2024 was 122,468 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that North Kesteven's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Kesteven increased by 3.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Kesteven was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Kesteven

The average (median) age fell to 46.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Kesteven has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Kesteven is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Kesteven's population of 122,468 usual residents was made up of:

  • 20,414 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.7%)
  • 72,777 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.4%)
  • 29,277 people aged 65 years and over, (23.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Kesteven has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Kesteven, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Kesteven
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Kesteven, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 455 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 893 births and 1,348 deaths in North Kesteven.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,614 (1.3%). There were 7,663 people entering the area and 6,049 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Kesteven's population of 276 (0.2%) as a result of 516 people entering the area and 240 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Kesteven was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Kesteven in mid-2023 is 121,115.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 185 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 273 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 88 people.
